main.description: A board within a forum. Lives in the forum account's repo. Subforums reference their parent board.

parent.description: Parent board for subforums. Must reference an app.atmobb.forum.board in the same repo.

category.description: Category this board is grouped under on the index. Must reference an app.atmobb.forum.category in the same repo.

topic.description: Normalized topic slug (lowercase, hyphen-separated). Boards across the atmosphere sharing a topic merge their threads; appviews do the joining.

topicFederation.description: Whose boards merge into this board's topic window. Absent means open.

topicAllow.description: Allowlist mode: forums whose same-topic boards merge here.

order.description: Sort position within the parent (or the forum root).

access.description: Who can read this board. Defaults to public when absent.

public.description: Anyone can read; threads and replies are public repo records.

space.description: Members-only board. Threads and replies live in the referenced permissioned space rather than public repos.
The at:// URI of the permissioned space backing this board (at://<did>/space/<type>/<skey>).
